cost.what: model calls per run once a skill exists
cost.note: Most of this average comes from one skill. The other two ask nothing at all on this class; the third asks on nearly every instance because it does not transfer cleanly.

shape.what: what resolved each step when the data differed

verify.what: the verdict on work that was not done

offline.threshold: no drop beyond the runs that needed a question
offline.restriction: The drop is not the execution needing a model - a compiled execution makes no such call. The drop is transfer: a step that does not resolve asks a question, and with nothing to ask, that run is lost. So the property holds exactly for the part of a class a skill transfers to.

artifact.what: size, structure and signability of a compiled skill
artifact.threshold: under 2 KB, valid JSON, every step declares its outcome

traces.threshold: every step carries its tier and its verdict
